files.docs/roster.md:
# Shift roster notes

The depot runs two dispatch desks after the evening peak: loading and
recovery. Roster swaps are agreed a week ahead and logged with the depot
supervisor.

The recovery desk closes at the same time as the loading desk on public
holidays.

turns.prompt: The Riverside shuttle dispatch board runs a nightly test job after the depot closes. The console output from last night's run is saved at ci/nightly_board.txt, and it lists every test the runner executed. Report the outcome of that run as a single word, either passed or failed. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
